[NCBK.6.2] When a rule's `call` action fires, the dispatcher invokes this
callback with `{ service, correlation, args, arg_count, timetag, rule_name }`.
`correlation` is never NULL and never empty ([LCRS.3.1]). `args` holds one typed
argument per kwarg the call supplies ([NCBK.6.10]), sorted by name; an optional
kwarg the call omits is absent. `timetag` and `rule_name` are the firing
activation's identity, the pair that joins the call to its recorded `CallIssued`
and `RuleFireAnnotation` ([RFCS.21.1]). A `call` runs inside a firing, so `timetag`
is never `0` ([NCBK.2.12]) and `rule_name` is never NULL, here and on
`DS_EV_ACTION_CALL` ([NCBK.2.3]). Everything is engine-owned and borrowed for the
callback's duration.
